settings.name: Daniyal Aslam
settings.title: Best value furniture piece in Pakistan
settings.content: At Rs. 10,500 this is the best value furniture piece in Pakistan right now! The twisted geometric wireframe base looks hypnotic and modern. Solid black marble top too.

settings.name: Rabia Imran
settings.title: Spiral sunburst base is a conversation starter
settings.content: The spiral sunburst metal base is an absolute conversation starter. Everyone who walks into our lounge notices it immediately. Clean marble top and lightweight enough to move when needed.

settings.name: Salman Zafar
settings.title: Incredible geometric design
settings.content: Incredible geometric design! Looks much more expensive than 10.5k. The gold powder coating is smooth and the marble has nice natural veining.

settings.name: Hina Kashif
settings.title: Adds so much character to the lounge
settings.content: Very pretty and modern center table. The sunburst spiral detail underneath adds so much character. Delivery was quick and packaging was secure.

settings.name: Shahid Nawaz
settings.title: Low profile & airy design
settings.content: Bought this for our apartment living room. Its low profile and airy wireframe base make the room feel open and spacious while still looking very luxury.

settings.name: Mehak Fatima
settings.title: Glossy marble & prompt delivery
settings.content: Super stylish! Arrived within 3 days in Lahore. Perfectly leveled on the floor and the marble top is glossy and flawless.

settings.name: Arslan Khalid
settings.title: Great build quality & fair pricing
settings.content: Great build quality, unique geometric spiral center, and very fair pricing. Gull e Gulzar's finishing is always top tier.
